flowchart TD
  subgraph SVC["Service d'accessibilite"]
    A["app/src/main/java/com/musheer360/swiftslate/service/AssistantService.kt"] --> B["app/src/main/java/com/musheer360/swiftslate/service/FocusedEditableFinder.kt"]
    A --> C["app/src/main/java/com/musheer360/swiftslate/service/CommandRunner.kt"]

explication: AssistantService detecte le champ de texte actif et CommandRunner execute la commande tapee, aussi declenchee depuis le menu de selection ProcessTextActivity. Il recupere la commande et la cle API puis appelle Gemini ou un endpoint compatible OpenAI selon ProviderConfig.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: AssistantService detects the active text field and CommandRunner executes the typed command, which can also be triggered from the ProcessTextActivity selection menu. It retrieves the command and the API key then calls Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint depending on ProviderConfig.
